data.narrative:
Sagar Defence Engineering, a Series A defense & security company that has raised $25.4M to date, is evaluated against a comparable universe of 10 peers in the same sector and stage cohort—comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implies $51M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comparable set yields a $1.0B implied valuation; the peer range spans $125M to $3.0B, with sampled peers including Dream Security ($3.0B, Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B, Series B), and Castelion ($1.0B, Series B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $43M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $525M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around market positioning relative to later-stage peers and the degree to which Sagar's technology and commercialization trajectory justify valuation toward the upper quartile of the peer set. Key variables include traction since the $25.4M raise, addressable market penetration, and relative defensibility of its core offering within the defense and security sector.
